approach: Matching decompilation of the retail Xbox executable: each function is rebuilt with the period-correct compiler and must produce exactly the same bytes.
notes: An independent, non-commercial preservation project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft, Bungie or 343 Industries.
